talent.orbisarcana.fire.echo.desc: Fire spells stack Heat on the target up to 5; at 5 it bursts in a radius of 2
talent.orbisarcana.fire.root.desc: Burning from your spells lasts 30% longer
talent.orbisarcana.fire.a1.desc: Heat bursts set nearby enemies on fire
talent.orbisarcana.fire.b1.desc: Immune to being set on fire
talent.orbisarcana.fire.b2.desc: Taking damage while burning grants a 4 HP shield (20 s cooldown)
talent.orbisarcana.earth.echo.desc: Absorbed damage builds charge; the next attack spell releases it as a wave
talent.orbisarcana.earth.root.desc: +20% cast stability while standing on the ground
talent.orbisarcana.earth.b1.desc: −10% damage taken while Bulwark is at 50% or more
talent.orbisarcana.earth.b2.desc: A lethal hit leaves you at 1 HP (5 min cooldown)
talent.orbisarcana.water.echo.desc: Healing and support build stacks; at 3 the next cast is instant
talent.orbisarcana.water.b1.desc: Healing jumps to a second ally (30%)
talent.orbisarcana.water.b2.desc: Healing removes one debuff (10 s cooldown)
talent.orbisarcana.air.echo.desc: Moving in combat builds charge; dashes spend it for extra power
talent.orbisarcana.air.root.desc: No fall damage up to 10 blocks
talent.orbisarcana.air.a2.desc: Dashes leave a cutting wind trail
talent.orbisarcana.ice.echo.desc: Slows stack up to 5; at 5 the target freezes for 1.5 s
talent.orbisarcana.ice.root.desc: Smaller movement penalty while casting ice
talent.orbisarcana.ice.a2.desc: Shattering a freeze sends shards around
talent.orbisarcana.ice.b2.desc: Below 30% HP you gain an ice shell (90 s cooldown)
talent.orbisarcana.lightning.echo.desc: Hits mark targets; the next discharge jumps to marked ones
talent.orbisarcana.lightning.b2.desc: When hit, you spark the attacker (4 s cooldown)
talent.orbisarcana.nature.echo.desc: Effective casts plant sprouts (up to 3); after 5 s they heal or sting
talent.orbisarcana.light.echo.desc: Protection and healing build charge; when full, a cleansing pulse for allies
talent.orbisarcana.light.root.desc: 25% of overheal becomes a shield (up to 4 HP)
talent.orbisarcana.light.a1.desc: +20% damage to undead and marked targets
talent.orbisarcana.light.b2.desc: Allies within 6 blocks take 5% less damage
talent.orbisarcana.dark.echo.desc: Debuffs leave marks; hitting a mark consumes it for damage and mana
talent.orbisarcana.dark.a2.desc: Consuming 3 marks releases a blinding flash
talent.orbisarcana.dark.b1.desc: 2 s invisibility after a kill (30 s cooldown)
talent.orbisarcana.dark.b2.desc: Mobs lose track of you when you teleport
talent.orbisarcana.astral.echo.desc: Casts place stars (up to 3); three stars release a gravity pulse
talent.orbisarcana.astral.a2.desc: A 4th star is possible; a rhombus doubles the pulse
talent.orbisarcana.astral.b1.desc: −20% projectile damage with a star nearby
talent.orbisarcana.astral.b2.desc: The pulse pulls you to its centre
screen.orbisarcana.schools.title: Schools — dominant: %s
screen.orbisarcana.schools.not_dominant: Talents work and can be picked only while the school is dominant (Resonance Altar)
message.orbisarcana.school.echo_hint: The %s Echo and the root passive unlock at resonance 1 — use this school spells
spell.orbisarcana.flame_dash.m10: enemies on the path are set on fire and pushed
spell.orbisarcana.ash_spiral.desc: A spinning fire vortex at a point for 4 s.
spell.orbisarcana.ash_spiral.m5: +1 s, the vortex pulls enemies in
spell.orbisarcana.ash_spiral.m10: the vortex slowly follows your aim
spell.orbisarcana.ash_spiral.m15: ends with a fire pillar, ×2 damage in the centre
spell.orbisarcana.tidal_stream.desc: Hold: a cone of water pushes enemies back and puts out fire.
spell.orbisarcana.tidal_stream.m10: the stream heals allies in the cone
spell.orbisarcana.water_prison.desc: A bubble holds an enemy for 2 s.
spell.orbisarcana.water_prison.m15: the bubble bursts in a wave, pushing everyone nearby
spell.orbisarcana.stone_spear.desc: A spike of earth runs along a line and hurts everyone in its way.
spell.orbisarcana.stone_spear.m15: a line of 5 spikes, the last one stuns
spell.orbisarcana.granite_oath.desc: A 6 HP stone shield for 8 s.
spell.orbisarcana.granite_oath.m5: a stone impulse when the shield breaks
spell.orbisarcana.granite_oath.m15: can be cast on the ally you look at
spell.orbisarcana.fault_line.desc: A crack wave runs from the chosen point.
spell.orbisarcana.fault_line.m10: the crack turns towards the nearest enemy
spell.orbisarcana.fault_line.m15: ends with a stone cage for 2 s
